Daily Quiz.question: ১) 'Calliban' is a character in -
Daily Quiz.exp: The Tempest is a comedy of William Shakespeare. Character of The Tempest are Calliban, Ariel, Miranda, Ferdinand, Prosperno etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'Belinda' is a important character which was created by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Alexander Pope is a poet of Augusta Period. 'The Rape of the Lock' is the famous Epic of Alexander Pope. Baron, Belinda, Arial are the important character of 'The Rape of the Lock'.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) 'Ophelia' is an important character in the Shakespearean play?
Daily Quiz.exp: Hamlet is a Tragedy of William Shakespeare. The character of Hamlet are Hamlet, Ophelia, Claudius, Gertrude, Horatio etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) 'Brutus' is a famous character of Shakespeare in -
Daily Quiz.exp: Julius Caesar is a famous Tragedy of William Shakespeare. Julius Caesar was a ruler of Rome about 2000 years ago. Main character of Julius Caesar are Antony, Caesar, Brutus etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) 'Shylock' is a famous character of -
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The Way of the World
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Merchant of Venice is a famous comedy by William Shakespeare.
The important character of The Merchant of Venice are - Antonio, Shylock, Portia, Bassanio, Jessica, etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) 'Desdemona' is a famous character of William Shakespeare in -
Daily Quiz.exp: Othello is a famous Tragedy of William Shakespeare. The Character of Othello are Othello, Desdemona, Brabantio, Iago, Cassio etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Clarrisa is the important characters of-
Daily Quiz.exp: Clarrisa and Peter are the important characters of Mrs. Dalloway by Virginia woolf.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Pip and Estella are the important character of-
Daily Quiz.exp: Great Expectations is the famous Novel of Charles Dickens. Pip, Estella, Miss Havisham are the important character of Great Expectations.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Mephistophilis the important character of-
Daily Quiz.exp: Doctor Faustus is a famous Tragedy (Morality play) of Christopher Marlowe. Mephistophilis, Lucifer are the important character of Doctor Faustus.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Oliver is a character in.........
Daily Quiz.exp: 'As You Like It' is a famous comedy of William Shakespeare. Important character of 'As You Like It' are Oliver, Orlando, Rosalind etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Protagonist of Pride and Prejudice is -
Daily Quiz.exp: 'Pride and Prejudice' is a famous Novel of Jane Austen. The Important character of 'Pride and Prejudice' are Mrs Darcy, Elizabeth Bennet.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who said 'An unexamined life is not worth living'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Socrates said that 'An unexamined life is not worth living'. 'Necessity is the mother of invention' said by Plato and 'Man is by nature a political animal' (the Politics) said by Aristotle.

Daily Quiz.question:
১৩) 'But I have promises to keep
And miles to go before I sleep' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Robert Frost is an American writer. Famous quotation of Robert Frost: But I have promises to keep and miles to go before I sleep and miles to go before I sleep. (Stopping by woods on a snowy evening).

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) 'Justice delayed is justice denied' was state by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Famous quotation of Gladstone- Justice delayed, justice denied, justice hurried, justice buried.

Daily Quiz.question:
১৫) 'East is east and west is west
Never the twain shall meet' was stated by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Famous quotation of Rudyard Kipling- East is east and west is west, Never the twain shall meet.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) 'It is our duty to live as long as we can' was authored by-
Daily Quiz.exp: G. B. Shaw is a greatest Dramatist of modern English literature. Important quotation of GB Shaw are 'It is our duty to live as long as we can', 'Nine shoulders out of ten are born fools', 'God is on the side of big battalions'.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who said that 'Sorrows are the best educator'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Alfred Tennyson is a famous Victorian poet. His famous quotation are 'Sorrows are the best educator', 'The old order changeth yielding place to new', 'Authority forgets a dying king', 'Knowledge comes but wisdom lingers'.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) 'Nature never did betray the heart that loved her' is a quotation by-
Daily Quiz.exp: William Wordsworth is a famous Romantic poet. His famous quotation are 'Child is the father of man', 'Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting', 'Nature never did betray the heart that loved her', 'Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings', 'Poet is the breath and final speed of knowledge', 'Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher'.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) 'The more we study, the more we discover our ignorance' was state by-
Daily Quiz.exp: PB Shelley is a famous Romantic poet. His famous quotation are 'The more we study, the more we discover our ignorance', 'Fear not the future, weep not for the past', 'Our sweetest songs are those that tell of saddest thought', 'If Winter comes can spring be far behind?', 'Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) 'We first make our habits than habits make us' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp: John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism. His famous quotation are 'They think too little talk too much', 'We first make our habits than habits make us', 'Jealousy is the proof of love'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) 'All the perfumes of Arabian will not sweeten this little hand's is a quotation from-
Daily Quiz.exp: Macbeth is a tragedy of Shakespeare. Famous quotation of MacBeth are 'Your face is a book, where men may read stress matters', 'Life is but a walking shadow', 'All the perfumes of Arabian will not sweeten this little hand's'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) 'Cowards die many times before their death' taken from -
Daily Quiz.exp: Julius Caesar is a tragedy of Shakespeare. Famous quotation of Julius Caesar is 'Cowards die many times before their death'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) 'Revenge is a kind of wild justice' said by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose is Francis Bacon. Famous quotation of Bacon are 'Revenge is a kind of wild justice', 'Unmarried men are best friends, best Masters, best servants but not always best subjects', 'Old wood best to burns, old wine to drink, old friends to trust and old author to read', 'Opportunity makes a thief', 'It is impossible to love and be wise', 'History makes man wise'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) 'A thing of beauty is a joy forever' taken from the writings of-
Daily Quiz.exp: John Keats is a famous poet of Romantic Period. His famous quotation are 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty', 'A thing of beauty is a joy forever', 'Heartld melodies are sweet but those unheard are sweeter'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) 'Eternal vigilance is the price of liberty' stated by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Thomas Jefferson was An American founding father and was The author of the declaration of independence of USA. He was the third president of USA. His famous quotation is 'Eternal vigilance is the price of liberty'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) 'Revenge is sweet especially to women' is taken from the writings of-
Daily Quiz.exp: Lord Byron is the rebel poet of English literature. His famous quotation are 'Revenge is sweet especially to women', 'Men's conscience is the Oracle of God', 'Man's love is of man's life a thing apart, it is women's whole existence'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) 'It is easier to forgive an enemy than to forgive a friend' taken from the writings of-
Daily Quiz.exp: William Blake was both poet and painter. Famous quotation of Blake are 'It is easier to forgive an enemy than to forgive a friend', 'All pray in their distress'.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) 'It is the best time, it is the worst time, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity stated' by-
Daily Quiz.exp: It is the best time, it is the worst time, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity' said by Charles Dickens (A tale of two cities)

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) 'Childhood shows the man as morning shows the day' was state by-
Daily Quiz.exp: John Milton is a great Master of verse in the puritan period. He is an Epic poet in English literature. His famous quotations are 'Childhood shows the man as morning shows the day', 'It is better to reign in hell than to serve in heaven', 'Death is the golden key that opens the place of eternity'.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) 'Charms strike the sight but merit strikes the heart' stated by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Alexander Pope is a Mock Heroic Poet. His famous quotation are 'Charms strike the sight but merit strikes the heart', 'A little learning is a dangerous thing', 'To err is human, to forgive is divine', 'An honest man is the noblest work of God', 'The proper study of mankind is man', 'Fools rush in where angles fear to tread', 'Hope springs eternal in the human breast'.
